title: Add Now I Get It! DevLog Posts
description:
Integrate blog posts from the Now I Get It! application blog (https://nowigetit.us/blog) into johndamask.com. Posts should appear in the combined feed alongside Substack, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Jekyll blog posts, with a branded 'Now I Get It! DevLog' source badge in black and gold with an SVG lightbulb icon.

Source: GitHub Issue jbdamask/jbdamask.github.io#2

Acceptance Criteria:
- Now I Get It! DevLog posts appear in the combined feed on johndamask.com sorted by date
- Posts are fetched automatically via GitHub Actions on an hourly schedule
- Branded source badge displays with black background (#0a0d17), gold text (#e8a838), and SVG lightbulb icon
- New posts trigger a Jekyll site rebuild via workflow_run chaining
- Posts render in text-only card format (no thumbnails)

title: Create RSS fetch script for Now I Get It! blog
description:
Create scripts/fetch_nowigetit.py modeled on scripts/fetch_substack.py. The script fetches the RSS feed at https://nowigetit.us/blog/feed.xml, parses standard RSS 2.0 XML (items with title, link, pubDate, description, guid), and writes posts to _data/nowigetit-posts.yml.

Key implementation details:
- Date parsing: datetime.strptime(pub_date_str, '%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %Z') — confirmed RFC 822 format
- No image extraction needed — feed contains no images, set image field to empty string
- source field: 'nowigetit'
- Merge/dedup: URL-keyed dictionary pattern (same as fetch_substack.py lines 114-124)
- Excerpt: first 200 chars of description
- On fetch failure: print error, exit with code 1, preserve existing data file

Reference: scripts/fetch_substack.py for the exact pattern to follow.

Source: GitHub Issue jbdamask/jbdamask.github.io#2

Acceptance Criteria:
- scripts/fetch_nowigetit.py exists and is executable
- Running python scripts/fetch_nowigetit.py produces _data/nowigetit-posts.yml
- Output YAML entries have fields: title, source (= nowigetit), url, date (YYYY-MM-DD), excerpt (<=200 chars), image (= empty string)
- Running the script twice produces no duplicates (URL-keyed dedup works)
- Script exits with code 1 if RSS fetch fails, preserving existing data file
- Typecheck passes

title: Create GitHub Actions workflow for Now I Get It! fetch
description:
Create .github/workflows/fetch-nowigetit.yml modeled on .github/workflows/fetch-substack.yml.

Workflow name: 'Fetch Now I Get It Posts' (this exact name is referenced by the jekyll.yml workflow_run trigger).

Configuration:
- Triggers: schedule (cron: '0 * * * *') + workflow_dispatch
- Permissions: contents: write
- Runner: ubuntu-latest
- Steps:
  1. Checkout repository (actions/checkout@v4)
  2. Setup Python 3.11 (actions/setup-python@v4)
  3. Install dependencies: pip install requests PyYAML
  4. Run: python scripts/fetch_nowigetit.py
  5. Commit and push if changed (same git config pattern as fetch-substack.yml)
- Commit message: 'Update Now I Get It posts'

Reference: .github/workflows/fetch-substack.yml for the exact pattern.

Source: GitHub Issue jbdamask/jbdamask.github.io#2

Acceptance Criteria:
- .github/workflows/fetch-nowigetit.yml exists with name 'Fetch Now I Get It Posts'
- Workflow has hourly cron schedule (0 * * * *) and workflow_dispatch trigger
- Workflow installs requests and PyYAML, runs scripts/fetch_nowigetit.py
- Workflow commits with message 'Update Now I Get It posts' only when data changes
- Workflow YAML is valid (no syntax errors)
- Typecheck passes

title: Design branded SVG lightbulb badge for Now I Get It! DevLog
description:
Design and implement the branded source badge for Now I Get It! DevLog posts in the combined feed.

Badge specifications:
- Label text: 'Now I Get It! DevLog'
- Background color: #0a0d17 (Now I Get It! site dark background)
- Text color: #e8a838 (Now I Get It! site gold accent)
- Icon: Inline SVG lightbulb before the text, styled in gold (#e8a838)
- Size: Must match existing .post-source badges (padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem, border-radius: 10px, font-size: 0.65rem, font-weight: 600)

The SVG lightbulb should be a simple outline matching the Now I Get It! logo (classic lightbulb shape with screw base). Reference the logo at https://nowigetit.us/logo.png for the design.

Implementation:
- Add CSS class .post-source.nowigetit to index.html styles
- The SVG will be inserted via the JavaScript sourceLabel in renderCombinedPosts()

Source: GitHub Issue jbdamask/jbdamask.github.io#2

Acceptance Criteria:
- CSS class .post-source.nowigetit exists with background #0a0d17 and color #e8a838
- Badge includes inline SVG lightbulb icon before text
- Badge is visually consistent in size with .post-source.substack, .post-source.linkedin, .post-source.blog
- SVG lightbulb renders correctly at badge scale (no overflow, proper alignment)
- Verify in browser
- Typecheck passes

title: Update Jekyll deploy workflow to chain with Now I Get It! fetch
description:
Modify .github/workflows/jekyll.yml to add the new fetch workflow to the workflow_run trigger array, so the Jekyll site rebuilds when new Now I Get It! posts are fetched.

Change the workflow_run.workflows array from:
  workflows: ["Fetch Substack Posts", "Fetch Twitter Posts"]
to:
  workflows: ["Fetch Substack Posts", "Fetch Twitter Posts", "Fetch Now I Get It Posts"]

This is a one-line change on line 17 of jekyll.yml. Do not modify any other part of the workflow.

Source: GitHub Issue jbdamask/jbdamask.github.io#2

Acceptance Criteria:
- .github/workflows/jekyll.yml workflow_run.workflows array includes 'Fetch Now I Get It Posts'
- Existing triggers for 'Fetch Substack Posts' and 'Fetch Twitter Posts' are preserved unchanged
- No other changes to jekyll.yml
- Typecheck passes

title: Add frontend integration for Now I Get It! DevLog posts
description:
Integrate Now I Get It! DevLog posts into the frontend rendering pipeline by modifying index.html and assets/js/substack-feed.js. Changes to index.html: - Add hidden data div block for nowigetit posts (after the Substack block, before closing ): {% if site.data.nowigetit-posts %} {% for post in site.data.nowigetit-posts %}
{% endfor %} {% endif %} Changes to assets/js/substack-feed.js: - Add getNowigetitPosts() function (same pattern as getSubstackPosts(), querying '.nowigetit-post-item', source: 'nowigetit') - Add 'nowigetit' case in renderCombinedPosts() sourceLabel logic with the branded SVG badge (from Task 5) - Add nowigetitPosts to the allPosts array in DOMContentLoaded handler Posts should render without thumbnails (text-only card format) and sort by date with all other sources. Source: GitHub Issue jbdamask/jbdamask.github.io#2 Acceptance Criteria: - index.html has hidden div.nowigetit-post-item elements rendering site.data.nowigetit-posts - assets/js/substack-feed.js has getNowigetitPosts() function - Now I Get It! DevLog posts appear in the combined feed sorted by date - Posts render without thumbnails (text-only card format) - Source badge shows 'Now I Get It! DevLog' with inline SVG lightbulb, black bg, gold text - Verify in browser - Typecheck passes
